'''Winsafra Battle Droid Heaven, errrr, Naboo :P''' is a [[Dark]] constructed list published on [[Game Players Network]].

== Deck info ==
* '''Player:''' [[Winsafra]]
* '''Published:''' 12 December 2001 (Game Players Network)
* '''GPN category:''' Standard
* '''Format:''' [[Premiere - Reflections III]]
* '''Side:''' [[Dark]]
* '''Starting Card:''' {{CardLink|Invasion|Theed-D-invasion.gif}}
* '''Strategy:''' Invasion
* '''GEMP Importable deck:''' [[Media:PR3 Invasion Winsafra DS 2001 GPN.txt |Download]]

== Strategy ==

Basically, use everyone you can to control Naboo. Droids, go rock em! Shootin Jedi like their nothin? how could you go wrong, and then recycle the destiny 8 blasters from the dead droids :P
and did you forget the droid racks where dead droids go? :P
(aka Battle Droid Heaven)
